request_payload.title: A follow-up study of MPS I patients treated with laronidase enzyme replacement therapy for 6 years.

mentions.sentence: Recombinant human alpha-L-iduronidase (Aldurazyme, laronidase) was approved as an enzyme replacement therapy for patients with the lysosomal storage disorder, mucopolysaccharidosis I (MPS I).

mentions.sentence: Sleep apnea was decreased in four of five patients and the airway size index improved.
Cardiac disease evaluations showed no progression to heart failure or cor pulmonale but pre-existing significant valve disease did progress in some patients.
